what: FAQ rows that open stickily. The question bar and the answer panel are drawn in the same surface color and placed together inside a gooey filter (blur 6 · alpha ×20 −9). On click, the answer panel, lifted 6px, grows by the answer height over .5s expo.out and drops away from the bar like a droplet. The answer text floats up .08s later from 8px below (power2.out), and on close it shrinks along the same curve and melts back into the bar

options.gap: Gap between question bar and answer panel (px), default 6
options.one: 1 opens only one at a time, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Answer panel (inside row) — first child is the answer text

note: Line fill color is --kf-surface. The gooey filter is made one per part with a new id

from.where: index.html .an-faq ”Questions, answered.” (original morphing accordion · macc goo)
